description: Use this when the user asks what happened to a card, or what changed lately, and a list helps: with holding_id, that stack's story (newest first, with its picture); without, the recent changes, optionally for one deck or place (id or name) and the last N days. Reads the same data as card_history and recent_activity and changes nothing. Each line says who made it: say so when it was not you (another assistant, a key, the web app). Relay `plan_limit` when present; `more` means lines not shown.

deck.description: Recent changes to this deck (id or name)

holding_id.description: One stack's story; omit for the recent changes

place.description: Recent changes in this place (location id or name)

name: show_history

card.description: The card whose story this is; null for the recent changes

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

in_collection.description: The stack is still in the collection; null for the recent changes

text.description: Who made it, and what changed

undone.description: An undo put this change back

more.description: There are more lines than shown

older_hidden.description: Entries older than the plan shows, kept and shown on Plus

anyOf.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

since.description: "In your collection since <date>, in <place>": the stack is older than its history

title: Show what changed
